title: Run Identity Binding V1
description: The exact identities and versions one optimization run consumed and produced, under traigent.content_identity.v1: the agent version, the dataset version (dataset_root), the evaluator version and HOW it was resolved, and per trial the multiset of examples actually evaluated (evaluated_root + members) and the provider versions actually observed. This is the record a certificate binds (docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md, 'What certificates bind'). It records CANDIDATES only: applying or promoting a winner is a separate, compare-and-set event on the agent head owned by the Director contract, and is never implied by a run record. Additive; no existing contract changes. Every string pattern in this file ends with the portable end anchor (?![\s\S]) instead of $: in Python's re (which Python jsonschema uses) $ also matches before a trailing newline, so '^x$' would accept 'x\n' -- a second spelling of one identifier. (?![\s\S]) means end-of-string in both ECMA-262 and Python.

EvaluatorVersionBindingV1.description: Which evaluator scored the trials. resolution says whether the version was WITNESSED at scoring time (the scorer reported the version it executed) or only DECLARED at session start. A certificate MUST NOT make an evaluator-version claim from a declared-only binding.

manifest.description: The manifest version_digest was computed from, so the issuer can recompute it.

TrialIdentityV1.description: One trial's identity facts. candidate is the agent version this trial's configuration defines (the base build with this trial's config applied).

observed_provider_versions.description: Empty means nothing was observed (for example a mocked run) -- an honest unknown, not 'no providers'.

agent.description: The base agent version the run started from.

base_head_generation.description: The agent head generation captured when the run STARTED. A later promotion of any candidate from this run is a compare-and-set against exactly this value (Director contract); recorded here so a certificate can show which head its candidates were measured against.

search_set.description: When the run searched on one split and evaluated on another: the search/selection split's identity. Overlap with the evaluation examples is measured on example_id.

RunIdentityBindingV1.description: record_state='complete' requires: base_head_generation; a certifiable agent (manifest inlined, coverage complete); a complete dataset identity; every trial's candidate as a certifiable agent version; and the evaluator manifest inlined. Only complete records are certifiable. What the issuer may then BIND is further restricted to server-recorded linkage and server-witnessed evaluator versions (docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md section 11).
